literal_meaning: নবমাসে বা ছয়মাস অন্তর (every nine months or six months interval)
figurative_meaning_en: Rarely, occasionally after a long interval
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নমাসে ছমাসে একবার দেখা দেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He shows up once in a blue moon.
I read this book every now and then.
note: The idiom likely derives from 'নবমাসে ছয়মাসে', emphasizing long gaps in occurrence, common in Bengali oral tradition.
